animations.name: O Demiurgo — Yaldabaoth
animations.label: Andar
animations.description: Complete seamless walking locomotion cycle IN PLACE to the right. Serpentine lower body undulates in alternating coils against ground, upper torso sways rhythmically, wings flex subtly, staff travels with hand, orb remains held. No human legs. Return to initial pose.

animations.name: O Demiurgo — Yaldabaoth
animations.label: Arremesso da esfera
animations.description: Throw the sphere from the free hand towards the RIGHT: draw orb hand back, twist torso for anticipation, swing arm forward and release the dark orb to fly right off canvas, extend throwing hand, then recover neutral pose with orb restored for next attack. Other hand keeps staff. Clear throw, not staff strike.

animations.name: O Demiurgo — Yaldabaoth
animations.label: Ritual celeste
animations.description: Perform solemn celestial conjuration ritual: slowly lift the cage-topped staff high overhead, hold it raised as a restrained mystical pale silver-violet light shines down over head shoulders and raised staff, then lower staff back to neutral. Keep the orb held in other hand. ONLY the subtle mystical light and raised staff convey summoning moon and sun; do NOT draw a moon or sun or other summoned objects.

animations.name: O Demiurgo — Yaldabaoth
animations.label: Derrota
animations.description: Defeat non-looping: stagger in pain, head and crown droop, release orb and staff, wings fold and collapse, serpentine coils buckle as torso sinks heavily to ground, end motionless slumped on tail with dropped staff beside body. Stay collapsed at end, never recover or resurrect.

animations.name: O Demiurgo — Yaldabaoth
animations.label: Ritual sem luz
animations.description: Ritual sem efeitos de luz: erguer o cajado, sustentar a pose e retornar.
